calls.title: Messages and calls
calls.lead: Your account's settings: they also apply in ANTSIA. They decide whether a call to you rings, and what your connections see of you.
calls.notOffered: DIASPORALE does not offer calls yet: no call button appears here. These settings already apply to calls made to you in ANTSIA.
calls.demoNotice: Demo: no call is made here. These fictional settings last as long as the page.

outside.ringHint: A call rings, whether or not it comes from one of your connections.
outside.silentHint: The default choice. A call from someone outside your connections does not ring: it is written to your call log, and the caller sees an unanswered call. A call started in a group you belong to, or accepted in a match, does not depend on this choice.

calls.readReceiptsHint: In one-to-one conversations, here as in ANTSIA. They are mutual: when off, others no longer see when you read their messages, and you no longer see when they read yours.
calls.voicemailHint: When you do not answer, the caller can leave you a voice message. You cannot listen to it in DIASPORALE yet.
calls.presenceHint: Your connections see whether you are online, on a call or on “Do not disturb”. Turned off, you no longer appear at all.
calls.callWaitingHint: During a call, a second call is put on hold for you. Turned off, the caller is told you are busy.

dnd.title: Do not disturb
dnd.hint: No call rings until the time you choose, seven days at most.

errors.call_dnd_past: The end of the quiet period has already passed: check your device's clock.
errors.call_dnd_too_long: A quiet period lasts seven days at most: check your device's clock.
